test: IDUI Test 04 (see PROTOCOL.md amendments A3 and A4)
tier: C - the owner judging rendered frames. Not Tier A, not Tier B.
question: Does the IDUI constitution (arm C) raise the owner's keep rate above an ungoverned generator (A) and above a curated allowlist (B)?
answer: No, and the question turned out to be the wrong instrument. Keep rate describes the judge's taste; the claim under test is about validity. See conclusion.
judge: The owner - who wrote the hypotheses, whose taste the engine is compiled from, and who can therefore not be blinded to an arm that differs enough to differ.

instrument.tool: macos-betta-metal/judge (bash) driving BettaTest04 --judge; K keeps, space or return rejects, u undoes
instrument.renderer: the production shader (Sources/BettaMetalLab/Shaders.metal) compiled at runtime, at 3840x2160, moving

A.name: raw random
A.description: every parameter uniform across its full domain; nothing governs it

B.name: allowlist
B.description: bands enumerated from where the eight locked presets sit - a possibility library

C.name: IDUI exclusions
C.description: the raw domains with only the exclusions that name a real failure

instrument.round1: Arms A, B and C shuffled; every frame through one of the eight locked landscape compositions (column composition = its id). Constitution v5.
instrument.round2: Four arms in shuffled blocks levelled at every boundary (verify-arms PASS): A and C-random on a seed-derived framing inside the envelope (composition = r), B and C-locked on the locked eight. The C pair shares one style per seed, so only the crop moves between them.
instrument.blinding: The arm was hidden from the judge and revealed only in the log. The owner's own objection stands on record: any arm different enough to differ is recognisable on sight, so the comparison is blind only in the band where the arms look alike.

pooled_note: Pooled C is round one C plus round two C-locked: the same constitution on the same eight crops. C-random is reported on its own.
conclusion: Arms A and C are indistinguishable at this n. Arm B sits above both, at about half of A and C's output variety (variety-20260908.json).

Composition and render fidelity move the rate more than the arm does: per-crop keep rates in round one span roughly forty points, and the same arm on the phone (phone-verdicts-20260908.json) keeps at about two thirds of its Mac rate.
A fifth, "truly raw" arm was proposed to widen the gap and the owner rejected it: it would be recognisable, so not blind. That closed the design.

Keep rate is therefore not an instrument for the frozen claim. The claim is about validity - every seed valid, on identity, no appearance decision in the generator - and validity is measured in tier-a-20260908-metal-v5.json and determinism-20260907.json, not here.
figures_note: Two judged frames from round one, the same arm and the same crop, recovered by BettaTest04 --recall from their rows (the judgement records arm, seed and framing, and each reproduces exactly) and reduced from 5120x2880 to 960 wide for the page. Both pass every contract; the judge kept one. Rendered from the working tree at cbc6be1 with the uncommitted recall mode; the generator and constitution are the committed ones. Illustrations, not measurements.
